correctness.rationale: The explicit three-stage exponential-race calculation gives P=2(q²+5q+7)/(3(q+3)(q+4)); its derivative has positive numerator on all q≥0, and its half-crossing polynomial has unique nonnegative root (1+√33)/2. A separately implemented forward mass-flow calculation matches nine exact rational q values. For minimality, all 7 triangle-containing connected graph classes within the lower-order/lower-edge bounds are generated from every labeled graph; the 129 possible seed/target comparisons have exact rational half-differences whose cleared numerators are identically zero or have one sign coefficientwise. Positive rate sums ensure the denominators never vanish. Graphs without triangles are parameter-independent.

value.rationale: The claim identifies the minimum network order and edge count needed for reinforcement alone to reverse two vertices’ arrival ordering, and provides an exact algebraic crossover. Infection order is an established observable for inferring contagion mechanisms; the minimal network is mathematically forced rather than an arbitrary finite slice. The formula yields a sharp small-network benchmark absent from the initiating simulations. No extension to epidemiological persistence or large-network universality is claimed.
